accepted_warnings: The external connectivity probe timed out after 3 seconds; it has no map-load or gameplay authority.

release_head_delta.runtime_registry_change: Both manifests advance their runnable-release evidence link from V18 to V22; the river ID, scenario ID, map package, ordinal, tier, runnable flag, and availability remain unchanged.

authority_boundary.runnable_claim: Free Run launches the committed L_Zambezi package with the vertical-slice gameplay stack and live cooked-field water.
authority_boundary.terrain: Copernicus GLO-30 remains collision and height-query authority; dense-tile relief, adaptive facade refinement, and dry-scarp outcrops are bounded non-colliding procedural presentation infill.
authority_boundary.outcrops: Rights-reviewed generic rock analogs only; no Batoka lithology, geospatial, collision, hydraulic, raft-force, navigation, or rapid-line authority.
authority_boundary.ecology: Project-owned procedural render-only ground-cover and woody analogs with no exact-species claim.
authority_boundary.water_rendering: Solver wet-cell geometry with render-only transmitting optics and raft-safe foam occlusion; no solver-state, collision, buoyancy, or raft-force authority changes.
authority_boundary.hydraulics: Feature-tagged procedural reference hydraulics, not validated rapid-specific real-world hydraulics.

open_external_acceptance_gates: A named whitewater water-VFX and environment-art reviewer must approve the foam, crest, hole, spray, mist, reflection, transmission, shoreline-contact, terrain, and ecology presentation across representative flow bands.
Qualified guides for the represented rivers must approve rapid identity, aeration placement, line and hazard readability, and raft/swimmer occlusion at the represented flows.
A geospatial or technical-art reviewer must approve source alignment and the labeled procedural terrain, bank, bathymetry, rapid-geometry, and dry-scarp outcrop infill boundaries.
A rights and provenance reviewer must approve every production texture, mesh, reference-media use, attribution, and redistribution record.

A safety and gameplay-readability reviewer must approve that foam, spray, mist, vegetation, lighting, terrain dressing, raft, and characters do not hide hazards, swimmers, rescue targets, or solver failures.
Target-platform qualification must pass desktop performance, memory, streaming, fresh-machine rendering, and required VR or low-power readability budgets.
The product owner must approve the integrated moving-camera river, raft, equipment, character, animation, and water interaction presentation before M9 or photoreal promotion.
